releases.notes:
![icon](https://github.com/Jaffe2718/Fabric-Microphone-Text-Input/blob/1.1.4-1.19.4/src/main/resources/assets/mcmti/icon.png)
## What's new?
Now users can set whether to automatically send voice recognition messages.

If so, the result of speech recognition will be automatically sent.

If not, voice recognition messages will be cached in the chat input field.

![image](https://github.com/Jaffe2718/Fabric-Microphone-Text-Input/blob/1.1.1-1.19.3/src/main/resources/assets/mcmti/icon.png)
## What's New in 1.1.1+1.19.3?
1. If you cannot load the acoustic model, you will be prompted when entering the game;
2. Messages sent using speech recognition are marked with ⌈Speech Input⌋.

![image](https://github.com/Jaffe2718/Fabric-Microphone-Text-Input/blob/1.1.1-1.19.2/src/main/resources/assets/mcmti/icon.png)
## What's New in 1.1.1+1.19.2?
1. If you cannot load the acoustic model, you will be prompted when entering the game;
2. Messages sent using speech recognition are marked with ⌈Speech Input⌋.
